paper_title: Limits on axion-like particles from Mrk 421 with 4.5-year period observations by ARGO-YBJ and Fermi-LAT
suggested_experiment_name: ARGO-YBJ and Fermi-LAT combined Mrk 421 observations
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis
notes: Paper reports combined 95% C.L. upper limit on ALP-photon coupling g_agamma from 4.5-year observations of blazar Mrk 421 using ARGO-YBJ and Fermi-LAT data across ten activity phases. The constraint is mass-dependent, spanning the range ~[2×10^-11, 6×10^-11] GeV^-1 for ALP mass ~5×10^-10 eV ≲ m_a ≲ 5×10^-7 eV. Encoded as a two-point horizontal line connecting the lower and upper bounds of the coupling range at the mass extremes. No significant ALP-photon oscillation effect was detected. The limit extends the excluded region compared to CAST and other astrophysical constraints, particularly for m_a ≲ 2×10^-9 eV and near m_a ≃ 2×10^-7 eV. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.85, 30)) | Vision: Exclusion boundary traced from FIG. 6 (main combined limit plot). The red contour represents the excluded region at 95% C.L. from combined ARGO-YBJ and Fermi-LAT observations of Mrk 421. The boundary shows a characteristic shape with a minimum coupling around 1e-8 eV and rises steeply at lower masses. The CAST limit (g_agamma < 6.6e-11 GeV^-1) is shown as a horizontal line at the top. The plot also shows constraints from H.E.S.S., PKS 2155-304, and NGC 1275 for comparison.
